chunks.text: This vault should describe what is actually deployed, proven, blocked, or ready. Claims intended for public sales pages should point back to a proof note, report, receipt, screenshot, or live route. Review truth: route clients who want to talk about their experience to the review intake. Route prospects who ask for reviews or social proof to the public review wall. chunks.title: Production Blockers
chunks.heading: Citadel Forge
chunks.text: Citadel Forge is locally stood up with Postgres, Forgejo, control plane, and portal containers. Production push is blocked by external account and deployment decisions: - Real domains for portal, control, and Forgejo. - DNS pointed at the production server. - ACME email for HTTPS certificates. - Production auth decision. - Stripe price IDs and webhook setup. - Forgejo runner registration token and workflow proof. - Offsite backup target and restore proof.

chunks.title: Production Blockers
chunks.heading: Client Drop Vault
chunks.text: Client Drop Vault checks and smoke pass locally. Live upload proof is blocked by Google Drive service-account quota unless a Shared Drive, user-owned folders, or domain-wide delegation is configured.

chunks.title: Production Blockers
chunks.heading: Node OS
chunks.text: Node OS prep passed local checks, but full ISO build and boot proof need a host with enough disk for the NixOS ISO closure, recommended 30 to 50 GB free.

chunks.title: Production Blockers
chunks.heading: SkyeGateFS27
chunks.text: SkyeGateFS27 is the auth and gateway authority for the ecosystem. Production hardening depends on explicit CORS origins, admin auth policy, billing credentials if top-ups are active, rate limit settings, and stable deployment path.

chunks.text: - PRODUCTIONREADINESSREPORT. md - metraiyux0slivee2ereport. json - test-artifacts/live-e2e-metraiyux/ - proof-recipes/metraiyux-public-proof. json - metraiyux0ssite/brain/live-surface-registry. json - Skyes Over London Reviews proof wall: https://skyes-over-london-reviews. pages. dev/skyes-over-london-reviews-expanded - Skyes Over London review intake and 0S QA batch rule: submit-review. html - 0S QA - five approved reviews - production publish.

chunks.title: Proof Ledger
chunks.heading: Proof Standard
chunks.text: A claim is stronger when it has all four: - Live URL or local route. - Test command or proof recipe. - Dated result. - Screenshot, JSON report, or receipt artifact.

chunks.title: Proof Ledger
chunks.heading: Missing Proof Should Become Action
chunks.text: If a note contains a useful claim without proof, create an operator action instead of treating it as sales language. Review submissions are proof candidates, not proof, until the 0S QA queue confirms consent, public-name preference, category fit, and claims safety. Five approved unpublished reviews are required before a production batch should be pushed into the wall.

chunks.text: - Public proof router for showing live surfaces. - White-label client deck handoff. - Valuation brief and marketing copy. - Production readiness report for serious technical review. - SkyeGateFS27 proof surface for auth and gateway positioning. - Skyes Over London Reviews proof wall for buyers asking what clients say: https://skyes-over-london-reviews. pages. dev/skyes-over-london-reviews-expanded. - Skyes Over London live review intake for happy clients who want to talk about their experience: https://skyes-over-london-reviews. pages. dev/submit-review. html.

chunks.title: Sales And Handoff Map
chunks.heading: Buyer-Safe Framing
chunks.text: Use proof-backed language: - "Live proof route available. " - "Production gates identified. " - "Local checks passed. " - "External-account setup required before final production push. " Avoid implying that placeholder billing, external accounts, legal filings, or customer-specific credentials are complete until they are actually verified.

chunks.title: Sales And Handoff Map
chunks.heading: Review Routing
chunks.text: If a prospect asks for testimonials, reviews, client proof, social proof, or customer experience, send the review wall and keep the claim grounded in the public page. If an existing client wants to leave a review, send the intake form and explain that 0S QA reviews consent and proof safety before anything is published.
